digest.en: The US Navy’s SSN(X) program stalls while China closes the submarine gap in the Pacific. Simultaneously, Germany opens a war crime trial over Nord Stream, blaming Ukrainian state actors. These two fronts define the current strategic friction.
digest.hi: सऊदी अरब में अरामको के मुख्यालय पर मिसाइलों से हमले की खबर ने तेल बाजार को हिला दिया है। इसी घंटे ब्रिटेन में हिंदूओं के खिलाफ नफरत के मामलों में 15 प्रतिशत की वृद्धि का आंकड़ा भी सामने आया है। दोनों घटनाएं अलग-अलग क्षेत्रों में सुरक्षा और सामाजिक स्थिरता पर नए सवाल खड़ी कर रही हैं।

articles.title: US Navy’s SSN(X) won’t arrive for years as China closes sub gap
articles.summary: The US Navy issued a sources-sought notice for its next-generation SSN(X) attack submarine. This move addresses the aging fleet while China closes the undersea gap. Chinese shipyards now offer superior capacity and acoustic stealth, challenging American naval dominance in the region. As the US Navy lays the groundwork for its next-generation SSN(X) attack submarine to replace its aging fleet, the US’s longstanding undersea supremacy faces an intensifying test against China’s rapid naval buildup, advancing acoustic stealth and superior shipyard capacity.

articles.title: Trump's Ambassador to Greece resigns after allegations of improper conduct
articles.summary: The Trump administration asked its ambassador to Greece to resign on October 13. She faced severe criticism over allegations of improper and possibly illegal conduct. The allegations covered actions taken before and during her tenure in Athens, prompting the immediate request for her departure. Mr. Trump's administration said on Tuesday (October 13) it had asked her to leave her post after she faced severe criticism over allegations she engaged in improper and possibly illegal conduct before and during her tenure in Athens.

articles.title: Elon Musk and Mukesh Ambani’s feud over Starlink
articles.summary: Elon Musk argues India’s mobile internet market unfairly favors the Ambani family. He claims Starlink deserves a fair chance to compete in the country. Critics counter that allowing the service raises significant sovereignty and security concerns for the Indian government. Elon Musk believes that India’s mobile internet market is skewed to favour the Ambani family and that his Starlink service deserves a fair chance in the country.

articles.title: Zelenskyy to visit Britain as Burnham pledges fresh support for Ukraine
articles.summary: Zelenskyy visits Britain as Andy Burnham pledges new support for Ukraine. The trip follows a U. S. deal with Russia on diesel exports. Trump recently suggested replacing Zelenskyy as Ukraine’s leader, adding pressure to the diplomatic visit. The meeting comes at a difficult time for the Ukrainian President, days after the U. made a deal with Russia for diesel exports and U.

articles.title: Saudi coalition strikes Yemen oil sites after Houthi attacks
articles.summary: The Saudi-led coalition struck Yemen Petroleum Company facilities near Sanaa. This followed deadly Houthi attacks on Saudi soil, including Riyadh airport. Civilians were ordered to evacuate the Al-Sabaha station before the strikes began. The Saudi-led coalition had earlier warned civilians to evacuate the Al-Sabaha station near the Houthi-held capital, which belongs to the Yemen Petroleum Company (YPC), following a spate of deadly Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia, particularly on Riyadh airport.

articles.title: 'We'll Keep Waiting': Afghanistan's Dead-End Road To China
articles.summary: Satellite imagery confirms the Taliban completed a road to the China-Afghanistan border. Beijing shows no signs of opening the militarized boundary. The infrastructure project remains a dead end for trade routes. Satellite imagery sourced by RFE/RL confirms Taliban claims they have completed a road that leads up to China's remote border with Afghanistan. However there is no indication Beijing intends to open the militarized boundary any time soon.

articles.title: Indonesia wildfire fuelled by El Niño razes almost 300 homes
articles.summary: An El Niño-fueled wildfire on Sumatra island destroyed nearly 300 homes in Bangka Belitung province. Hundreds of residents evacuated as shifting winds drove the blaze toward settlements. The incident adds to the country’s ongoing battle with devastating blazes and haze. Hundreds of people displaced in Bangka Belitung province as shift in wind direction drove blaze towards settlementA forest fire on Indonesia’s Sumatra island fuelled by El Niño has razed nearly 300 homes, forcing hundreds of people to evacuate, an official said on Tuesday as the country battles devastating blazes and haze. Residents first spotted the fire approaching their village in Bangka Belitun.

articles.title: How Ukraine's Strikes On Data Centers Disrupted Taxis, Shopping, And Business In Russia And Beyond
articles.summary: Ukrainian drones hit three Yandex data centers. Repairs will take months. The strikes disrupted taxi services, online shopping, and business operations across Russia and other countries where the tech firm operates. Ukrainian drone strikes on three data centers operated by Russia’s Yandex will reportedly take months to repair and have caused widespread disruption in everyday life across Russia and other countries the sprawling tech company operates in.

articles.title: 800 million young people face a future without jobs
articles.summary: The UNDP head warned 800 million young people in developing economies will lack jobs. This projection covers the coming years without immediate action. The agency launched two initiatives to boost investment and employment. 800 million young people face a future without jobs.

articles.title: ‘Need for UN has never been greater,’ UN chief says, proposing slimmer $3.3 billion budget for 2027
articles.summary: António Guterres proposed a $3.3 billion budget for 2027. This represents a $40.8 million cut from previous plans. He cited climate disruption, AI, war, and hunger as drivers for the need. Amid climate disruption, an AI revolution, war and growing hunger, “the need for the United Nations has never been greater,” Secretary-General António Guterres said on Tuesday, presenting a $3.3 billion programme budget proposal for next year – a cut of $40.8 million.

articles.title: Germany To Start Nord Stream 'War Crime' Trial With Prosecutors Blaming Ukrainian 'State
articles.summary: German prosecutors will begin a war crime trial regarding the Nord Stream pipeline explosions. The case marks the first public, sworn testimony on the incident after years of speculation. Prosecutors are blaming Ukrainian state actors for the sabotage. After four years of speculation, leaks, and briefings by anonymous sources, the world is finally about to hear evidence given publicly under oath in a German courtroom about how the Nord Stream gas pipelines were blown up -- in a case that could prove politically explosive.

articles.title: Latin American organised crime ‘may operate in 16 European countries’
articles.summary: Latin American organised crime groups may now operate in sixteen European countries. A Guardian investigation links the fivefold rise in cocaine seizures to these expanding networks. Cartels have established deep roots across the continent over the last decade. Cocaine seizures in Europe are up more than fivefold in 10 years as a host of cartels take root. A four-month Guardian investigation reveals the true scale of a continent-wide shiftA four-month investigation by the Guardian has revealed that the surge in cocaine trafficking to Europe is directly linked to the expanding presence of Latin American criminal networks in Europe, where they have forged.

articles.title: US turning B-52 bomber into long-range China ship killer
articles.summary: The US Navy plans to equip B-52 bombers with AGM-158C Long-Range Anti-Ship Missiles to counter China's navy. Lockheed Martin will integrate the weapons under a sole-source contract. However, severe munition shortages and operational vulnerabilities may limit the strategic impact of this upgrade. While the US is arming its long-serving B-52 with potent ship-killing missiles to take on China’s expanding navy, severe munition constraints and operational vulnerabilities could undermine its strategic impact.

articles.title: Zelenskyy Accuses Russia Of Breaking Trump's Cease-Fire On Energy Strikes
articles.summary: Trump defended allowing Russian diesel exports despite criticism from Ukraine, Europe, and Republicans. He claimed an energy cease-fire exists between Kyiv and Moscow. Neither side has confirmed the arrangement. The move drew sharp backlash from allied governments and domestic opponents. US President Donald Trump, in the face of sharp criticism from officials in Ukraine, Europe, and even his Republican party, defended his decision to allow Russian diesel exports and insisted an energy cease-fire between Kyiv and Moscow is in place despite a lack of confirmation from either side.

articles.title: Pulling Ethiopia and Eritrea Back from War
articles.summary: Ethiopia and Eritrea are edging closer to direct conflict, threatening stability in the Horn of Africa and Red Sea basin. Diplomatic efforts remain active to avert disaster. The situation risks escalating regional mayhem if tensions between Addis Ababa and Asmara continue to intensify. Addis Ababa and Asmara are edging closer to a direct conflict, which would cause further mayhem in the troubled Horn of Africa and the Red Sea basin.

articles.title: Zelenskyy Says Yandex Strikes Crippled Pro-Kremlin Bots But Tech Experts Question Evidence
articles.summary: Zelenskyy claimed Ukraine’s strikes on Yandex data centers reduced pro-Kremlin bots. He said the attacks crippled the network. Tech experts dispute this assessment. They question the evidence linking the strikes to a drop in bot activity. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said that Ukraine's recent attacks on Russian tech giant Yandex’s data centers have resulted in fewer Internet bots promoting pro-Kremlin hate, a claim that has been disputed by many technology researchers.

articles.title: Colombia peace deal must endure as insecurity grows, Security Council hears
articles.summary: The UN representative in Colombia stated the peace deal must endure despite growing insecurity. The agreement ended a decades-long insurgency nearly ten years ago. Rising violence threatens the stability of the accord. The official emphasized the need to prevent the deal from faltering. Nearly 10 years after Colombia signed a historic peace agreement to end a decades-long insurgency, the deal is under strain from growing insecurity – and the UN’s top official in the country says it cannot be allowed to falter.

articles.title: Drought and war push Darfur and Kordofan towards famine
articles.summary: The UN hunger monitor warned famine risk is rising in Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan. A severe El Niño drought compounds the impact of ongoing war in Sudan. Food security has deteriorated significantly in these conflict-affected regions. The situation remains critical for local populations. The risk of famine is growing in parts of Sudan already torn apart by war, as a severe El Niño drought makes life even harder in Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan, the UN-backed global hunger monitor warned on Monday.

articles.title: UNHCR chief warns refugee protection is buckling under cuts
articles.summary: UNHCR chief Barham Salih warned refugee protection is failing. The agency received only three billion dollars of its eight billion dollar need. One hundred seventeen million people are currently displaced. Funding gaps threaten the global asylum support system. The money is running out faster than needs are growing: with 117 million men, women and children now forced from their homes, the UN refugee agency (UNHCR) has received just $3 billion of the $8.5 billion it needs this year – and its chief, Barham Salih, warns that the global support system for asylum-seekers risks buckling.

articles.title: Trump Announces Energy Cease-Fire Between Ukraine, Russia As Countries Trade Strikes
articles.summary: Donald Trump announced that Russia and Ukraine agreed to an energy cease-fire. This follows his decision to ease restrictions on Russian diesel exports. He also called for a change in leadership in Kyiv. The two countries continued trading strikes during this period. US President Donald Trump said Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an energy cease-fire, following his earlier decision to ease restrictions on Russian diesel exports and his subsequent call for a change in leadership in Kyiv.

articles.title: As Russian Arms Exports Slide, Central Asia Shops Elsewhere
articles.summary: Central Asian states are shifting military procurement away from Russia toward India, China, Turkey, and Europe. This diversification grants them greater political flexibility in negotiations with Moscow. Analysts warn that mixing equipment from multiple suppliers creates long-term logistical and operational challenges. The shift reflects a strategic move to reduce reliance on a single arms supplier. Central Asian nations are increasingly turning to India, China, Turkey, and Europe for military equipment to reduce their dependence on Russia.

articles.title: House Republicans Move To Block Trump's Russia Diesel Deal
articles.summary: Representative Brian Fitzpatrick is forcing a House vote on legislation to block Russian oil purchases. This move directly challenges President Donald Trump's decision to ease restrictions on Russian diesel exports. Lawmakers warn the policy shift could help finance Moscow's war against Ukraine. The procedural maneuver tests the limits of congressional authority over executive trade decisions. Republican Representative Brian Fitzpatrick plans to force a House vote on legislation blocking Russian oil purchases, challenging President Donald Trump's decision to ease restrictions on Russian diesel exports as lawmakers warn the move could help finance Moscow's war against Ukraine.

articles.title: Controversial vaccine trial touted by RFK Jr gets go-ahead in Guinea-Bissau
articles.summary: Guinea-Bissau approved a controversial trial to withhold hepatitis B vaccines from thousands of newborns. Danish researchers will conduct the study. It aligns with the vaccine vision of US Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Recommended dose of hepatitis B vaccine will be withheld from thousands of newborns by Danish researchersA controversial research trial that will withhold hepatitis B vaccines from some African newborns was given approval to move forward this week. It is a central part of the vaccine vision for Robert F Kennedy Jr, the secretary of the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and a longtime.

articles.title: How Close Are Ethiopia and Eritrea to All-out War?
articles.summary: Crisis Group’s Alan Boswell discussed the fighting in Ethiopia’s Tigray region on Hold Your Fire. He analyzed the risk of direct war between Ethiopia and Eritrea. The conversation covered factors that might prevent further escalation in the Horn of Africa. In this episode of Hold Your Fire!, Richard is joined by Crisis Group’s Horn of Africa director, Alan Boswell, to discuss the fighting in Ethiopia’s Tigray region, the risk of direct war between Ethiopia and Eritrea and what may prevent further escalation.

articles.title: Toward a Thaw in the Cambodia-Thailand Border Conflict
articles.summary: Hostilities between Cambodia and Thailand ceased in late 2025 after two rounds of combat. The truce now faces growing strain. To prevent further war, both nations should restore normal diplomatic ties. They must also resume work on demarcating their shared border. Hostilities between Cambodia and Thailand ceased in late 2025, after two rounds of combat along the frontier. But the truce is under growing strain.

articles.title: आशुतोष रांका-सौरव दास की न्यायिक हिरासत पर बोले अभिजीत दीपके- 'मोदी जी हिम्मत है तो...'
articles.summary: सीजेपी नेता आशुतोष रांका और सौरव दास को न्यायिक हिरासत में भेजा गया। अभिजीत दीपके ने सरकार पर प्रश्न उठाया। उन्होंने तिरंगा फहराने को गलती नहीं माना। सीजेपी के फाउंडर अभिजीत दीपके ने कहा कि सीजेपी नेता आशुतोष रांका और सौरव दास को 5 दिन की न्यायिक हिरासत में भेज दिया गया है. सरकार पर निशाना साधते हुए दीपके ने कहा कि उनकी क्या गलती है?
